headline: Event Collector reliability fixes dominate; USTA deprecated in favour of USTAv4
summary_md:
- **AWS-GuardDuty** takes 70% of the day at +1,123/-110, fixing duplicate events and a fetch stall in its Event Collector (#45492).
- **USTA** is deprecated and **USTAv4** updated in the same commit — the day's only withdrawal (#45624).
- Nine packs move for 8 upstream commits, 1,606 lines added against 173 deleted; the snapshot head `c9f7d9d` is same-day.
- Ingestion reliability is the theme: GuardDuty, the **Okta** Event Collector (#45584) and the **Strata Logging Service** URL fallback (#45568) are three of the four largest packs.
- Modeling-rule housekeeping continues under CRTX-271523 with a **CiscoNexus** field-separator fix (#45626).

highlights.title: USTA is deprecated and USTAv4 updated in its place
highlights.detail: One commit moves both packs — USTA +7/-1 and USTAv4 +60/-31 — and it is also the snapshot head for the day (CIAC-17755, #45624).

highlights.title: AWS GuardDuty Event Collector stops duplicating events and stalling
highlights.detail: At +1,123/-110 it is both the largest change and the largest deletion count of the day, against 63 deleted lines everywhere else combined (XSUP-73410, #45492).

highlights.title: Strata Logging Service falls back to the migrated SLS URL
highlights.detail: The CortexDataLake pack gains 240 lines against a single deletion so the integration can recover when the oproxy URL is unreachable (#45568).

highlights.title: Okta Event Collector event fetching is made more reliable
highlights.detail: +85/-7, the third of the day's three collector-reliability fixes (XSUP-73675, #45584).

highlights.title: Unit 42 Threat Intelligence authentication is fixed under UCP mode
highlights.detail: +36/-2 clearing an auth error that occurred specifically with UCP authentication mode selected (XSUP-75305, #45604).

items.Packs/AWS-GuardDuty: +1,123/-110 fixing duplicate events and a fetch stall in the Event Collector (XSUP-73410, #45492) — 70% of the day's insertions and 64% of its deletions.
items.Packs/CortexDataLake: +240/-1 adding a fallback to the migrated Strata Logging Service URL when the oproxy URL is unreachable (#45568).
items.Packs/Okta: +85/-7 improving event-fetching reliability in the Okta Event Collector (XSUP-73675, #45584).
items.Packs/USTAv4: +60/-31, updated in the same commit that deprecates the original USTA pack (CIAC-17755, #45624).
items.Packs/Core: +40/-17; the day's one commit subject that names no pack is an error-classification change (CRTX-255682, #45540).
items.Packs/Unit42ThreatIntelligencebyPaloAlto: +36/-2 fixing an authentication error under UCP authentication mode (XSUP-75305, #45604).
items.Packs/AWS-SecurityHub: +8/-2 correcting the provider name in AWS Security Hub v2 (#45616).
items.Packs/CiscoNexus: +7/-2 fixing the modeling rule field separator (CRTX-271523, #45626).
items.Packs/USTA: +7/-1 marking the pack deprecated in favour of USTAv4 (CIAC-17755, #45624).
